regime_context: Canada/TSX: Big Banks lead with high durability and highly crowded positioning, while the absolute-trend gate (the one validated drawdown-control edge) remains helpful. Momentum ranks are a coincident focus lens, not a return forecast. Rotation is broad but directionally non-committal; no confirmed handoff is underway.
emerging_watch: Watch Base Metals & Copper vs. Big Banks margin. If margin narrows to <0.2 and Base Metals' durability improves past 0.5, a leadership handoff is forming; kill this watch if margin widens beyond 0.6 or Base Metals drops out of eligibility.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks hold the top rank, are eligible via the trend gate (validated for risk control), and show high durability (0.68) and broad breadth, suggesting disciplined participation can be maintained; however, crowding (z=1.05) demands a size-down approach, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowded positioning makes the theme vulnerable to sharp liquidation on any negative macro surprise, and momentum rank has no proven return-forecasting edge.

falsifier.text: If Big Banks loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips false) or its momentum rank falls below 3 for 5 consecutive days, the overweight case is invalidated.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: As the challenger (rank #2) with eligibility and no crowding, Base Metals offers diversification away from the crowded bank theme; moderate durability (0.47) tempers conviction, but the trend gate supports risk-managed exposure.
theses.dissent: Durability is notably lower than the leader, and rank has no predictive power; the theme could quickly underperform if risk-off flows return to banks.

falsifier.text: If Base Metals loses eligibility or its rank drops below 5 for 5 consecutive days, the lean is negated.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is ineligible (absolute-trend gate false), meaning it lacks the one validated drawdown-control edge in this market; rank 15 and mixed durability offer no countervailing signal, so an underweight/avoid stance is warranted until eligibility returns.
theses.dissent: Technology could mean-revert sharply, and the trend-gate filter may re-enter too late to capture a rapid bounce.

falsifier.text: If Technology becomes eligible (absolute-trend gate turns true) and its rank improves to top-10, the avoidance call is negated.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
